options.name: general:border_size
options.wiki_desc: size of the border around windows

options.name: general:gaps_in
options.wiki_desc: gaps between windows

options.name: general:gaps_out
options.wiki_desc: gaps between windows and monitor edges

options.name: general:float_gaps
options.wiki_desc: gaps between windows and monitor edges for floating windows `-1` means default

options.name: general:gaps_workspaces
options.wiki_desc: gaps between workspaces. Stacks with gaps_out.

options.name: general:col.inactive_border
options.wiki_desc: border color for inactive windows

options.name: general:col.active_border
options.wiki_desc: border color for the active window

options.name: general:col.nogroup_border
options.wiki_desc: inactive border color for window that cannot be added to a group (see `hl.dsp.window.deny_from_group` dispatcher)

options.name: general:col.nogroup_border_active
options.wiki_desc: active border color for window that cannot be added to a group

options.name: general:layout
options.wiki_desc: which layout to use. \[`"dwindle"`/`"master"`/`"scrolling"`/`"monocle"`\]

options.name: general:no_focus_fallback
options.wiki_desc: if true, will not fall back to the next available window when moving focus in a direction where no window was found

options.name: general:resize_on_border
options.wiki_desc: enables resizing windows by clicking and dragging on borders and gaps

options.name: general:extend_border_grab_area
options.wiki_desc: extends the area around the border where you can click and drag on, only used when `general.resize_on_border` is on.

options.name: general:hover_icon_on_border
options.wiki_desc: show a cursor icon when hovering over borders, only used when `general.resize_on_border` is on.

options.name: general:allow_tearing
options.wiki_desc: master switch for allowing tearing to occur. See [the Tearing page](../../Advanced-and-Cool/Tearing).

options.name: general:resize_corner
options.wiki_desc: force floating windows to use a specific corner when being resized (1-4 going clockwise from top left, 0 to disable)

options.name: general:snap:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable snapping for floating windows

options.name: general:snap:window_gap
options.wiki_desc: minimum gap in pixels between windows before snapping

options.name: general:snap:monitor_gap
options.wiki_desc: minimum gap in pixels between window and monitor edges before snapping

options.name: general:snap:border_overlap
options.wiki_desc: if true, windows snap such that only one border's worth of space is between them

options.name: general:snap:respect_gaps
options.wiki_desc: if true, snapping will respect gaps between windows(set in general:gaps_in)

options.name: general:modal_parent_blocking
options.wiki_desc: whether parent windows of modals will be interactive

options.name: general:locale
options.wiki_desc: overrides the system locale (e.g. `"en_US"`, `"es"`)

options.name: decoration:rounding
options.wiki_desc: rounded corners' radius (in layout px)

options.name: decoration:rounding_power
options.wiki_desc: adjusts the curve used for rounding corners, larger is smoother, 2.0 is a circle, 4.0 is a squircle. [2.0 - 10.0]

options.name: decoration:active_opacity
options.wiki_desc: opacity of active windows. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:inactive_opacity
options.wiki_desc: opacity of inactive windows. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:fullscreen_opacity
options.wiki_desc: opacity of fullscreen windows. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:shadow:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable drop shadows on windows

options.name: decoration:shadow:range
options.wiki_desc: Shadow range ("size") in layout px

options.name: decoration:shadow:render_power
options.wiki_desc: in what power to render the falloff (more power, the faster the falloff) [1 - 4]

options.name: decoration:shadow:sharp
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, will make the shadows sharp, akin to an infinite render power

options.name: decoration:shadow:color
options.wiki_desc: shadow's color. Alpha dictates shadow's opacity.

options.name: decoration:shadow:color_inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive shadow color. (if not set, will fall back to color)
curation: Gradient declared with -1 sentinel (descriptions shows ffffffff 0deg); nullable gradient

options.name: decoration:shadow:offset
options.wiki_desc: shadow's rendering offset.
curation: vec2 range [-250,250] only in source (vec2Range validator)

options.name: decoration:shadow:scale
options.wiki_desc: shadow's scale. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:glow:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable inner glow on windows

options.name: decoration:glow:range
options.wiki_desc: Glow range ("size") in layout px

options.name: decoration:glow:render_power
options.wiki_desc: in what power to render the falloff (more power, the faster the falloff) [1 - 4]

options.name: decoration:glow:color
options.wiki_desc: glow's color. Alpha dictates glow's opacity.

options.name: decoration:glow:color_inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive glow color. (if not set, will fall back to color)
curation: Gradient declared with -1 sentinel; nullable gradient

options.name: decoration:dim_modal
options.wiki_desc: enables dimming of parents of modal windows

options.name: decoration:dim_inactive
options.wiki_desc: enables dimming of inactive windows

options.name: decoration:dim_strength
options.wiki_desc: how much inactive windows should be dimmed [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:dim_special
options.wiki_desc: how much to dim the rest of the screen by when a special workspace is open. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:dim_around
options.wiki_desc: how much the `dim_around` window rule should dim by. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:screen_shader
options.wiki_desc: a path to a custom shader to be applied at the end of rendering. See `examples/screenShader.frag` for an example.

options.name: decoration:border_part_of_window
options.wiki_desc: whether the window border should be a part of the window

options.name: decoration:blur:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable kawase window background blur

options.name: decoration:blur:size
options.wiki_desc: blur size (distance)

options.name: decoration:blur:passes
options.wiki_desc: the amount of passes to perform

options.name: decoration:blur:ignore_opacity
options.wiki_desc: make the blur layer ignore the opacity of the window

options.name: decoration:blur:new_optimizations
options.wiki_desc: whether to enable further optimizations to the blur. Recommended to leave on, as it will massively improve performance.

options.name: decoration:blur:xray
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, floating windows will ignore tiled windows in their blur. Only available if new_optimizations is true. Will reduce overhead on floating blur significantly.

options.name: decoration:blur:noise
options.wiki_desc: how much noise to apply. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:contrast
options.wiki_desc: contrast modulation for blur. [0.0 - 2.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:brightness
options.wiki_desc: brightness modulation for blur. [0.0 - 2.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:vibrancy
options.wiki_desc: Increase saturation of blurred colors. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:vibrancy_darkness
options.wiki_desc: How strong the effect of `vibrancy` is on dark areas . [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:special
options.wiki_desc: whether to blur behind the special workspace (note: expensive)

options.name: decoration:blur:popups
options.wiki_desc: whether to blur popups (e.g. right-click menus)

options.name: decoration:blur:popups_ignorealpha
options.wiki_desc: works like ignore_alpha in layer rules. If pixel opacity is below set value, will not blur. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:blur:input_methods
options.wiki_desc: whether to blur input methods (e.g. fcitx5)

options.name: decoration:blur:input_methods_ignorealpha
options.wiki_desc: works like ignore_alpha in layer rules. If pixel opacity is below set value, will not blur. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: decoration:motion_blur:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable motion blur on moving / resizing windows

options.name: decoration:motion_blur:samples
options.wiki_desc: The amount of samples to render. More will mean clearer blur, at the cost of more compute.

options.name: animations:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enable animations

options.name: animations:workspace_wraparound
options.wiki_desc: enable workspace wraparound, causing directional workspace animations to animate as if the first and last workspaces were adjacent

options.name: input:kb_model
options.wiki_desc: Appropriate XKB keymap parameter. See the note below.

options.name: input:kb_layout
options.wiki_desc: Appropriate XKB keymap parameter

options.name: input:kb_variant
options.wiki_desc: Appropriate XKB keymap parameter

options.name: input:kb_options
options.wiki_desc: Appropriate XKB keymap parameter

options.name: input:kb_rules
options.wiki_desc: Appropriate XKB keymap parameter

options.name: input:kb_file
options.wiki_desc: If you prefer, you can use a path to your custom .xkb file.

options.name: input:numlock_by_default
options.wiki_desc: Engage numlock by default.

options.name: input:resolve_binds_by_sym
options.wiki_desc: Determines how keybinds act when multiple layouts are used. If false, keybinds will always act as if the first specified layout is active. If true, keybinds specified by symbols are activated when you type the respective symbol with the current layout.

options.name: input:repeat_rate
options.wiki_desc: The repeat rate for held-down keys, in repeats per second.

options.name: input:repeat_delay
options.wiki_desc: Delay before a held-down key is repeated, in milliseconds.

options.name: input:sensitivity
options.wiki_desc: Sets the mouse input sensitivity. Value is clamped to the range -1.0 to 1.0. [libinput#pointer-acceleration](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/pointer-acceleration.html#pointer-acceleration)

options.name: input:accel_profile
options.wiki_desc: Sets the cursor acceleration profile. Can be one of `"adaptive"`, `"flat"`. Can also be `"custom"`, see [below](#accel_profile). Leave empty to use `libinput`'s default mode for your input device. [libinput#pointer-acceleration](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/pointer-acceleration.html#pointer-acceleration) \[`"adaptive"`/`"flat"`/`"custom"`\]

options.name: input:force_no_accel
options.wiki_desc: Force no cursor acceleration. This bypasses most of your pointer settings to get as raw of a signal as possible. **Enabling this is not recommended due to potential cursor desynchronization.**

options.name: input:rotation
options.wiki_desc: Sets the rotation of a device in degrees clockwise off the logical neutral position. Value is clamped to the range 0 to 359.

options.name: input:left_handed
options.wiki_desc: Switches RMB and LMB

options.name: input:scroll_points
options.wiki_desc: Sets the scroll acceleration profile, when `accel_profile` is set to `"custom"`. Has to be in the form `"<step> <points>"`. Leave empty to have a flat scroll curve.

options.name: input:scroll_method
options.wiki_desc: Sets the scroll method. Can be one of `"2fg"` (2 fingers), `"edge"`, `"on_button_down"`, `"no_scroll"`. [libinput#scrolling](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/scrolling.html) [`"2fg"`/`"edge"`/`"on_button_down"`/`"no_scroll"`]

options.name: input:scroll_button
options.wiki_desc: Sets the scroll button. Has to be an int, cannot be a string. Check `wev` if you have any doubts regarding the ID. 0 means default.

options.name: input:scroll_button_lock
options.wiki_desc: If the scroll button lock is enabled, the button does not need to be held down. Pressing and releasing the button toggles the button lock, which logically holds the button down or releases it. While the button is logically held down, motion events are converted to scroll events.

options.name: input:scroll_factor
options.wiki_desc: Multiplier added to scroll movement for external mice. Note that there is a separate setting for [touchpad scroll_factor](#touchpad).

options.name: input:natural_scroll
options.wiki_desc: Inverts scrolling direction. When enabled, scrolling moves content directly, rather than manipulating a scrollbar.

options.name: input:follow_mouse
options.wiki_desc: Specify if and how cursor movement should affect window focus. See the note below. [`0`/`1`/`2`/`3`]

options.name: input:follow_mouse_threshold
options.wiki_desc: The smallest distance in logical pixels the mouse needs to travel for the window under it to get focused. Works only with follow_mouse = 1.

options.name: input:focus_on_close
options.wiki_desc: Controls the window focus behavior when a window is closed. When set to 0, focus will shift to the next window candidate. When set to 1, focus will shift to the window under the cursor. When set to 2, focus will shift to the most recently used/active window. [`0`/`1`/`2`]

options.name: input:mouse_refocus
options.wiki_desc: If disabled, mouse focus won't switch to the hovered window unless the mouse crosses a window boundary when `follow_mouse=1`.

options.name: input:float_switch_override_focus
options.wiki_desc: If enabled (1 or 2), focus will change to the window under the cursor when changing from tiled-to-floating and vice versa. If 2, focus will also follow mouse on float-to-float switches.
curation: enum-labels (0 off/1 on/2 also follow mouse) not in map

options.name: input:special_fallthrough
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, having only floating windows in the special workspace will not block focusing windows in the regular workspace.

options.name: input:off_window_axis_events
options.wiki_desc: Handles axis events around (gaps/border for tiled, dragarea/border for floated) a focused window. `0` ignores axis events `1` sends out-of-bound coordinates `2` fakes pointer coordinates to the closest point inside the window `3` warps the cursor to the closest point inside the window

options.name: input:emulate_discrete_scroll
options.wiki_desc: Emulates discrete scrolling from high resolution scrolling events. `0` disables it, `1` enables handling of non-standard events only, and `2` force enables all scroll wheel events to be handled

options.name: input:follow_mouse_shrink
options.wiki_desc: Shrinks the inactive window hitboxes used for focus detection by the specified number of pixels. This creates a dead zone in gaps between windows where moving the cursor will not change focus. Works only with follow_mouse = 1.

options.name: input:touchpad:disable_while_typing
options.wiki_desc: Disable the touchpad while typing.

options.name: input:touchpad:natural_scroll
options.wiki_desc: Inverts scrolling direction. When enabled, scrolling moves content directly, rather than manipulating a scrollbar.

options.name: input:touchpad:scroll_factor
options.wiki_desc: Multiplier applied to the amount of scroll movement.

options.name: input:touchpad:middle_button_emulation
options.wiki_desc: Sending LMB and RMB simultaneously will be interpreted as a middle click. This disables any touchpad area that would normally send a middle click based on location. [libinput#middle-button-emulation](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/middle-button-emulation.html)

options.name: input:touchpad:tap_button_map
options.wiki_desc: Sets the tap button mapping for touchpad button emulation. Can be one of `"lrm"` (default) or `"lmr"` (Left, Middle, Right Buttons). [`"lrm"`/`"lmr"`]

options.name: input:touchpad:clickfinger_behavior
options.wiki_desc: Button presses with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will be mapped to LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively. This disables interpretation of clicks based on location on the touchpad. [libinput#clickfinger-behavior](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/clickpad-softbuttons.html#clickfinger-behavior)

options.name: input:touchpad:tap-to-click
options.wiki_desc: Tapping on the touchpad with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will send LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively.

options.name: input:touchpad:drag_lock
options.wiki_desc: When enabled, lifting the finger off while dragging will not drop the dragged item. 0 -> disabled, 1 -> enabled with timeout, 2 -> enabled sticky. [libinput#tap-and-drag](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/tapping.html#tap-and-drag)
curation: enum-labels (0/1/2 semantics in wiki) not in map

options.name: input:touchpad:tap-and-drag
options.wiki_desc: Sets the tap and drag mode for the touchpad

options.name: input:touchpad:flip_x
options.wiki_desc: inverts the horizontal movement of the touchpad

options.name: input:touchpad:flip_y
options.wiki_desc: inverts the vertical movement of the touchpad

options.name: input:touchpad:drag_3fg
options.wiki_desc: enables three finger drag, 0 -> disabled, 1 -> 3 fingers, 2 -> 4 fingers [libinput#drag-3fg](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/latest/drag-3fg.html)

options.name: input:touchdevice:transform
options.wiki_desc: Transform the input from touchdevices. The possible transformations are the same as [those of the monitors](../Monitors/#rotating).

options.name: input:touchdevice:output
options.wiki_desc: The monitor to bind touch devices. The default is auto-detection. To stop auto-detection, use an empty string.

options.name: input:touchdevice:enabled
options.wiki_desc: Whether input is enabled for touch devices.

options.name: input:virtualkeyboard:share_states
options.wiki_desc: Unify key down states and modifier states with other keyboards. 0 -> no, 1 -> yes, 2 -> yes unless IME client

options.name: input:virtualkeyboard:release_pressed_on_close
options.wiki_desc: Release all pressed keys by virtual keyboard on close.

options.name: input:tablet:transform
options.wiki_desc: transform the input from tablets. The possible transformations are the same as [those of the monitors](../Monitors/#rotating).

options.name: input:tablet:output
options.wiki_desc: the monitor to bind tablets. Can be `"current"` or a monitor name. Leave empty to map across all monitors.

options.name: input:tablet:region_position
options.wiki_desc: position of the mapped region in monitor layout relative to the top left corner of the bound monitor or all monitors.

options.name: input:tablet:absolute_region_position
options.wiki_desc: whether to treat the `region_position` as an absolute position in monitor layout. Only applies when `output` is empty.

options.name: input:tablet:region_size
options.wiki_desc: size of the mapped region. When this variable is set, tablet input will be mapped to the region. `{0, 0}` or invalid size means unset.

options.name: input:tablet:relative_input
options.wiki_desc: whether the input should be relative

options.name: input:tablet:left_handed
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, the tablet will be rotated 180 degrees

options.name: input:tablet:active_area_size
options.wiki_desc: size of tablet's active area in mm

options.name: input:tablet:active_area_position
options.wiki_desc: position of the active area in mm

options.name: input:tablettool:eraser_button_mode
options.wiki_desc: Change the eraser button behavior on the tool. When set to `0`, use the default hardware behavior of the tool. When set to `1`, the eraser button on the tool sends a button event instead.

options.name: input:tablettool:eraser_button_override
options.wiki_desc: Set a button to be button event when eraser_button_mode is set to `1`. Has to be an int, cannot be a string. Must be a valid button (e.g. BTN_STYLUS) excluding fake buttons (e.g. BTN_TOOL_*) and keys (KEY_*). Check wev if you have any doubts regarding the ID. `0` means default.

options.name: input:tablettool:pressure_range_min
options.wiki_desc: Set the minimum pressure range for the tool, a negative number will set the default minimum pressure value. This is usually `0.0`

options.name: input:tablettool:pressure_range_max
options.wiki_desc: Set the maximum pressure range for the tool, a negative number will set the default maximum pressure value. This is usually `1.0`

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_distance
options.wiki_desc: in px, the distance of the touchpad gesture

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_touch
options.wiki_desc: enable workspace swiping from the edge of a touchscreen

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_invert
options.wiki_desc: invert the direction (touchpad only)

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_touch_invert
options.wiki_desc: invert the direction (touchscreen only)

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_min_speed_to_force
options.wiki_desc: minimum speed in px per timepoint to force the change ignoring `cancel_ratio`. Setting to `0` will disable this mechanic.

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_cancel_ratio
options.wiki_desc: how much the swipe has to proceed in order to commence it. (0.7 -> if > 0.7 * distance, switch, if less, revert) [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_create_new
options.wiki_desc: whether a swipe right on the last workspace should create a new one.

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, switching direction will be locked when you swipe past the `direction_lock_threshold` (touchpad only).

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock_threshold
options.wiki_desc: in px, the distance to swipe before direction lock activates (touchpad only).

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_forever
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, swiping will not clamp at the neighboring workspaces but continue to the further ones.

options.name: gestures:workspace_swipe_use_r
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, swiping will use the `r` prefix instead of the `m` prefix for finding workspaces.

options.name: gestures:close_max_timeout
options.wiki_desc: the timeout for a window to close when using a 1:1 gesture, in ms

options.name: gestures:scrolling:move_snap_to_grid
options.wiki_desc: when releasing the scroll move gesture, whether it should try to snap to the grid

options.name: gestures:scrolling:move_snap_cursor
options.wiki_desc: when releasing the scroll move gesture, whether it should snap the cursor to the newly focused window

options.name: group:insert_after_current
options.wiki_desc: whether new windows in a group spawn after current or at group tail

options.name: group:focus_removed_window
options.wiki_desc: whether Hyprland should focus on the window that has just been moved out of the group

options.name: group:merge_groups_on_drag
options.wiki_desc: whether window groups can be dragged into other groups

options.name: group:merge_groups_on_groupbar
options.wiki_desc: whether one group will be merged with another when dragged into its groupbar. *Note: enabling this option only works when combined with `drag_into_group = 2` and `merge_groups_on_drag = true`*

options.name: group:col.border_active
options.wiki_desc: active group border color

options.name: group:col.border_inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive (out of focus) group border color

options.name: group:col.border_locked_inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive locked group border color

options.name: group:col.border_locked_active
options.wiki_desc: active locked group border color

options.name: group:auto_group
options.wiki_desc: whether new windows will be automatically grouped into the focused unlocked group. *Note: if you want to disable auto_group only for specific windows, use [the "group barred" window rule](../Window-Rules/#group-window-rule-options) instead.*

options.name: group:drag_into_group
options.wiki_desc: whether dragging a window into a unlocked group will merge them. Options: `0` (disabled), `1` (enabled), `2` (only when dragging into the groupbar)

options.name: group:merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupbar
options.wiki_desc: whether dragging a floating window into a tiled window groupbar will merge them

options.name: group:group_on_movetoworkspace
options.wiki_desc: whether using movetoworkspace[silent] will merge the window into the workspace's solitary unlocked group

options.name: group:groupbar:enabled
options.wiki_desc: enables groupbars

options.name: group:groupbar:disable_when_only
options.wiki_desc: disable if contains single window. Considered only if enabled == true

options.name: group:groupbar:font_family
options.wiki_desc: font used to display groupbar titles, use `misc.font_family` if not specified

options.name: group:groupbar:font_weight_active
options.wiki_desc: font weight of active groupbar title

options.name: group:groupbar:font_weight_inactive
options.wiki_desc: font weight of inactive groupbar title

options.name: group:groupbar:font_size
options.wiki_desc: font size of groupbar title

options.name: group:groupbar:gradients
options.wiki_desc: enables gradients

options.name: group:groupbar:height
options.wiki_desc: height of the groupbar

options.name: group:groupbar:indicator_gap
options.wiki_desc: height of gap between groupbar indicator and title

options.name: group:groupbar:indicator_height
options.wiki_desc: height of the groupbar indicator

options.name: group:groupbar:stacked
options.wiki_desc: render the groupbar as a vertical stack

options.name: group:groupbar:priority
options.wiki_desc: sets the decoration priority for groupbars
curation: decoration priority; usually leave default; advanced

options.name: group:groupbar:render_titles
options.wiki_desc: whether to render titles in the group bar decoration

options.name: group:groupbar:scrolling
options.wiki_desc: whether scrolling in the groupbar changes group active window

options.name: group:groupbar:middle_click_close
options.wiki_desc: whether middle clicking the groupbar closes the clicked window

options.name: group:groupbar:rounding
options.wiki_desc: how much to round the indicator

options.name: group:groupbar:rounding_power
options.wiki_desc: adjusts the curve used for rounding groupbar corners, larger is smoother, 2.0 is a circle, 4.0 is a squircle. [2.0 - 10.0]

options.name: group:groupbar:gradient_rounding
options.wiki_desc: how much to round the gradients

options.name: group:groupbar:gradient_rounding_power
options.wiki_desc: adjusts the curve used for rounding gradient corners, larger is smoother, 2.0 is a circle, 4.0 is a squircle. [2.0 - 10.0]

options.name: group:groupbar:round_only_edges
options.wiki_desc: round only the indicator edges of the entire groupbar

options.name: group:groupbar:gradient_round_only_edges
options.wiki_desc: round only the gradient edges of the entire groupbar

options.name: group:groupbar:text_color
options.wiki_desc: color for window titles in the groupbar

options.name: group:groupbar:text_color_inactive
options.wiki_desc: color for inactive windows' titles in the groupbar (if unset, defaults to text_color)
curation: Color with -1 sentinel (unset -> fallback); needs nullable color widget

options.name: group:groupbar:text_color_locked_active
options.wiki_desc: color for the active window's title in a locked group (if unset, defaults to text_color)

options.name: group:groupbar:text_color_locked_inactive
options.wiki_desc: color for inactive windows' titles in locked groups (if unset, defaults to text_color_inactive)

options.name: group:groupbar:col.active
options.wiki_desc: active group bar background color

options.name: group:groupbar:col.inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive (out of focus) group bar background color

options.name: group:groupbar:col.locked_active
options.wiki_desc: active locked group bar background color

options.name: group:groupbar:col.locked_inactive
options.wiki_desc: inactive locked group bar background color

options.name: group:groupbar:gaps_out
options.wiki_desc: gap size between gradients and window

options.name: group:groupbar:gaps_in
options.wiki_desc: gap size between gradients

options.name: group:groupbar:keep_upper_gap
options.wiki_desc: add or remove upper gap

options.name: group:groupbar:text_offset
options.wiki_desc: adjust vertical position for titles

options.name: group:groupbar:text_padding
options.wiki_desc: set horizontal padding for titles

options.name: group:groupbar:blur
options.wiki_desc: applies blur to the groupbar indicators and gradients

options.name: misc:disable_hyprland_logo
options.wiki_desc: disables the random Hyprland logo / anime girl background. :(

options.name: misc:disable_splash_rendering
options.wiki_desc: disables the Hyprland splash rendering. (requires a monitor reload to take effect)

options.name: misc:col.splash
options.wiki_desc: Changes the color of the splash text (requires a monitor reload to take effect).

options.name: misc:font_family
options.wiki_desc: Set the global default font to render the text including debug fps/notification, config error messages and etc., selected from system fonts.

options.name: misc:splash_font_family
options.wiki_desc: Changes the font used to render the splash text, selected from system fonts (requires a monitor reload to take effect).

options.name: misc:force_default_wallpaper
options.wiki_desc: Enforce any of the 3 default wallpapers. Setting this to `0` or `1` disables the anime background. `-1` means "random". [-1/0/1/2]

options.name: misc:vrr
options.wiki_desc: controls the VRR (Adaptive Sync) of your monitors. 0 - off, 1 - on, 2 - fullscreen only, 3 - fullscreen with `video` or `game` content type [0/1/2/3]

options.name: misc:mouse_move_enables_dpms
options.wiki_desc: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if the mouse moves.

options.name: misc:key_press_enables_dpms
options.wiki_desc: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if a key is pressed.

options.name: misc:always_follow_on_dnd
options.wiki_desc: Will make mouse focus follow the mouse when drag and dropping. Recommended to leave it enabled, especially for people using focus follows mouse at 0.

options.name: misc:layers_hog_keyboard_focus
options.wiki_desc: If true, will make keyboard-interactive layers keep their focus on mouse move (e.g. wofi, bemenu)

options.name: misc:animate_manual_resizes
options.wiki_desc: If true, will animate manual window resizes/moves

options.name: misc:animate_mouse_windowdragging
options.wiki_desc: If true, will animate windows being dragged by mouse, note that this can cause weird behavior on some curves

options.name: misc:disable_autoreload
options.wiki_desc: If true, the config will not reload automatically on save, and instead needs to be reloaded with `hyprctl reload`. Might save on battery.

options.name: misc:enable_swallow
options.wiki_desc: Enable window swallowing

options.name: misc:swallow_regex
options.wiki_desc: The _class_ regex to be used for windows that should be swallowed (usually, a terminal). To know more about the list of regex which can be used [use this cheatsheet](https://github.com/ziishaned/learn-regex/blob/master/README.md).

options.name: misc:swallow_exception_regex
options.wiki_desc: The _title_ regex to be used for windows that should _not_ be swallowed by the windows specified in swallow_regex  (e.g. wev). The regex is matched against the parent (e.g. Kitty) window's title on the assumption that it changes to whatever process it's running.

options.name: misc:focus_on_activate
options.wiki_desc: Whether Hyprland should focus an app that requests to be focused (an `activate` request)

options.name: misc:mouse_move_focuses_monitor
options.wiki_desc: Whether mouse moving into a different monitor should focus it

options.name: misc:allow_session_lock_restore
options.wiki_desc: if true, will allow you to restart a lockscreen app in case it crashes

options.name: misc:session_lock_xray
options.wiki_desc: if true, keep rendering workspaces below your lockscreen

options.name: misc:session_lock_blur
options.wiki_desc: Enables blur for lockscreen. `session_lock_xray` must be enabled.

options.name: misc:background_color
options.wiki_desc: change the background color. (requires enabled `disable_hyprland_logo`)

options.name: misc:close_special_on_empty
options.wiki_desc: close the special workspace if the last window is removed

options.name: misc:on_focus_under_fullscreen
options.wiki_desc: if there is a fullscreen or maximized window, decide whether a tiled window requested to focus should replace it, stay behind or disable the fullscreen/maximized state. 0 - ignore focus request (keep focus on fullscreen window), 1 - takes over, 2 - unfullscreen/unmaximize [0/1/2]

options.name: misc:exit_window_retains_fullscreen
options.wiki_desc: whether closing a fullscreen window makes the next focused window to be fullscreened. 0 - disabled, 1 - enabled, 2 - only when closing a grouped window, 3 - only when closing a non-grouped window [0/1/2/3]
curation: wiki says int, source says Bool

options.name: misc:initial_workspace_tracking
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, windows will open on the workspace they were invoked on. 0 - disabled, 1 - single-shot, 2 - persistent (all children too)
curation: enum-labels (0 off/1 single-shot/2 persistent) wiki only

options.name: misc:initial_workspace_token_timeout
options.wiki_desc: the time in seconds a window has to open on its invoked workspace before the tracking token expires.

options.name: misc:middle_click_paste
options.wiki_desc: whether to enable middle-click-paste (aka primary selection)

options.name: misc:render_unfocused_fps
options.wiki_desc: the maximum limit for render_unfocused windows' fps in the background (see also [Window-Rules](../Window-Rules/#dynamic-effects) - `render_unfocused`)

options.name: misc:disable_xdg_env_checks
options.wiki_desc: disable the warning if XDG environment is externally managed

options.name: misc:disable_hyprland_guiutils_check
options.wiki_desc: disable the warning if hyprland-guiutils is not installed

options.name: misc:disable_watchdog_warning
options.wiki_desc: whether to disable the warning about not using start-hyprland

options.name: misc:lockdead_screen_delay
options.wiki_desc: delay after which the "lockdead" screen will appear in case a lockscreen app fails to cover all the outputs (5 seconds max)

options.name: misc:enable_anr_dialog
options.wiki_desc: whether to enable the ANR (app not responding) dialog when your apps hang

options.name: misc:anr_missed_pings
options.wiki_desc: number of missed pings before showing the ANR dialog

options.name: misc:screencopy_force_8b
options.wiki_desc: forces 8 bit screencopy

options.name: misc:disable_scale_notification
options.wiki_desc: disables notification popup when a monitor fails to set a suitable scale

options.name: misc:size_limits_tiled
options.wiki_desc: whether to apply min_size and max_size rules to tiled windows

options.name: binds:pass_mouse_when_bound
options.wiki_desc: if disabled, will not pass the mouse events to apps / dragging windows around if a keybind has been triggered.

options.name: binds:scroll_event_delay
options.wiki_desc: in ms, how many ms to wait after a scroll event to allow passing another one for the binds.

options.name: binds:workspace_back_and_forth
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, an attempt to switch to the currently focused workspace will instead switch to the previous workspace. Akin to i3's _auto_back_and_forth_.

options.name: binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, changing the active workspace (including to itself) will hide the special workspace on the monitor where the newly active workspace resides.

options.name: binds:allow_workspace_cycles
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, workspaces don't forget their previous workspace, so cycles can be created by switching to the first workspace in a sequence, then endlessly going to the previous workspace.

options.name: binds:workspace_center_on
options.wiki_desc: Whether switching workspaces should center the cursor on the workspace (0) or on the last active window for that workspace (1)

options.name: binds:focus_preferred_method
options.wiki_desc: sets the preferred focus finding method when using `hl.dsp.focus({ direction })`/`hl.dsp.window.move({ direction })`/etc. 0 - history (recent have priority), 1 - length (longer shared edges have priority)

options.name: binds:ignore_group_lock
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, dispatchers like `hl.dsp.window.move({ into_group })` and `hl.dsp.window.move({ out_of_group })` will ignore lock per group.

options.name: binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, when on a fullscreen window, `hl.dsp.focus({ direction })` will cycle fullscreen, if not, it will move the focus in a direction.

options.name: binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, when in a grouped window, `hl.dsp.focus({ direction })` will cycle windows in the groups first, then at each ends of tabs, it'll move on to other windows/groups

options.name: binds:disable_keybind_grabbing
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, apps that request keybinds to be disabled (e.g. VMs) will not be able to do so.

options.name: binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, moving a window or focus over the edge of a monitor with a direction will move it to the next monitor in that direction.

options.name: binds:allow_pin_fullscreen
options.wiki_desc: If enabled, Allow fullscreen to pinned windows, and restore their pinned status afterwards

options.name: binds:drag_threshold
options.wiki_desc: Movement threshold in pixels for window dragging and c/g bind flags. 0 to disable and grab on mousedown.

options.name: xwayland:enabled
options.wiki_desc: allow running applications using X11

options.name: xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor
options.wiki_desc: uses the nearest neighbor filtering for xwayland apps, making them pixelated rather than blurry

options.name: xwayland:force_zero_scaling
options.wiki_desc: forces a scale of 1 on xwayland windows on scaled displays.

options.name: xwayland:create_abstract_socket
options.wiki_desc: Create the [abstract Unix domain socket](../../Advanced-and-Cool/XWayland/#abstract-unix-domain-socket) for XWayland connections. (XWayland restart is required for changes to take effect; Linux only)

options.name: opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker
options.wiki_desc: reduces flickering on nvidia at the cost of possible frame drops on lower-end GPUs. On non-nvidia, this is ignored.

options.name: render:direct_scanout
options.wiki_desc: Enables direct scanout. Direct scanout attempts to reduce lag when there is only one fullscreen application on a screen (e.g. game). It is also recommended to set this to false if the fullscreen application shows graphical glitches. 0 - off, 1 - on, 2 - auto (on with content type 'game')

options.name: render:expand_undersized_textures
options.wiki_desc: Whether to expand undersized textures along the edge, or rather stretch the entire texture.

options.name: render:xp_mode
options.wiki_desc: Disables back buffer and bottom layer rendering.

options.name: render:ctm_animation
options.wiki_desc: Whether to enable a fade animation for CTM changes (hyprsunset). 2 means "auto" which disables them on Nvidia.

options.name: render:cm_enabled
options.wiki_desc: Whether the color management pipeline should be enabled or not (requires a restart of Hyprland to fully take effect)

options.name: render:send_content_type
options.wiki_desc: Report content type to allow monitor profile autoswitch (may result in a black screen during the switch)

options.name: render:cm_auto_hdr
options.wiki_desc: Auto-switch to HDR in fullscreen when needed. 0 - off, 1 - switch to `cm, hdr`, 2 - switch to `cm, hdredid`

options.name: render:new_render_scheduling
options.wiki_desc: Automatically uses triple buffering when needed, improves FPS on underpowered devices.

options.name: render:non_shader_cm
options.wiki_desc: Enable CM without shader. 0 - disable, 1 - whenever possible, 2 - DS and passthrough only, 3 - disable and ignore CM issues

options.name: render:cm_sdr_eotf
options.wiki_desc: Default transfer function for displaying SDR apps. `"default"` - Use default value (sRGB), `"gamma22"` - Treat unspecified as Gamma 2.2, `"gamma22force"` - Treat unspecified and sRGB as Gamma 2.2, `"srgb"` - Treat unspecified as sRGB

options.name: render:commit_timing_enabled
options.wiki_desc: Enable commit timing proto. Requires restart

options.name: render:icc_vcgt_enabled
options.wiki_desc: Enable sending VCGT ramps to KMS with ICC profiles

options.name: render:use_shader_blur_blend
options.wiki_desc: Use experimental blurred bg blending (glitched on rotated screens). Set to true if blur is missing with fp16 or keep_unmodified_copy

options.name: render:use_fp16
options.wiki_desc: Use FP16 buffers internally. 0 - disabled, 1 - enabled, 2 - enabled in hdr mode

options.name: render:keep_unmodified_copy
options.wiki_desc: Keep unmodified SDR frame copy for screensharing. 0 - disabled, 1 - on, 2 - auto (enabled in HDR with SDR modifiers). Set to 1 if screenshots are transparent.

options.name: render:non_shader_cm_interop
options.wiki_desc: 0 - external ctm (hyprsunset, etc.) is disabled in fullscreen, 1 - external ctm is enabled in fullscreen, 2 - external ctm is disabled for fullscreen photo/video/game content types

options.name: render:fp16_sdr_tf
options.wiki_desc: Internal workbuffer transfer function for fp16 in SDR mode. 0 - monitor, 1 - linear

options.name: cursor:invisible
options.wiki_desc: don't render cursors

options.name: cursor:no_hardware_cursors
options.wiki_desc: disables hardware cursors. 0 - use hw cursors if possible, 1 - don't use hw cursors, 2 - auto (disable when tearing)

options.name: cursor:no_break_fs_vrr
options.wiki_desc: disables scheduling new frames on cursor movement for fullscreen apps with VRR enabled to avoid framerate spikes (may require no_hardware_cursors = true) 0 - off, 1 - on, 2 - auto (on with content type 'game')

options.name: cursor:min_refresh_rate
options.wiki_desc: minimum refresh rate for cursor movement when `no_break_fs_vrr` is active. Set to minimum supported refresh rate or higher

options.name: cursor:hotspot_padding
options.wiki_desc: the padding, in logical px, between screen edges and the cursor

options.name: cursor:inactive_timeout
options.wiki_desc: in seconds, after how many seconds of cursor's inactivity to hide it. Set to `0` for never.

options.name: cursor:no_warps
options.wiki_desc: if true, will not warp the cursor in many cases (focusing, keybinds, etc)

options.name: cursor:persistent_warps
options.wiki_desc: When a window is refocused, the cursor returns to its last position relative to that window, rather than to the centre.

options.name: cursor:warp_on_change_workspace
options.wiki_desc: Move the cursor to the last focused window after changing the workspace. Options: 0 (Disabled), 1 (Enabled), 2 (Force - ignores cursor:no_warps option)

options.name: cursor:warp_on_toggle_special
options.wiki_desc: Move the cursor to the last focused window when toggling a special workspace. Options: 0 (Disabled), 1 (Enabled), 2 (Force - ignores cursor:no_warps option)

options.name: cursor:default_monitor
options.wiki_desc: the name of a default monitor for the cursor to be set to on startup (see `hyprctl monitors` for names)

options.name: cursor:zoom_factor
options.wiki_desc: the factor to zoom by around the cursor. Like a magnifying glass. Minimum 1.0 (meaning no zoom)
curation: often driven by dispatcher, not config

options.name: cursor:zoom_rigid
options.wiki_desc: whether the zoom should follow the cursor rigidly (cursor is always centered if it can be) or loosely

options.name: cursor:zoom_disable_aa
options.wiki_desc: disable antialiasing when zooming, which means things will be pixelated instead of blurry

options.name: cursor:zoom_detached_camera
options.wiki_desc: detach the camera from the mouse when zoomed in, only ever moving the camera to keep the mouse in view when it goes past the screen edges

options.name: cursor:enable_hyprcursor
options.wiki_desc: whether to enable hyprcursor support

options.name: cursor:hide_on_key_press
options.wiki_desc: Hides the cursor when you press any key until the mouse is moved.

options.name: cursor:hide_on_touch
options.wiki_desc: Hides the cursor when the last input was a touch input until a mouse input is done.

options.name: cursor:hide_on_tablet
options.wiki_desc: Hides the cursor when the last input was a tablet input until a mouse input is done.

options.name: cursor:use_cpu_buffer
options.wiki_desc: Makes HW cursors use a CPU buffer. Required on Nvidia to have HW cursors. 0 - off, 1 - on, 2 - auto (nvidia only)

options.name: cursor:sync_gsettings_theme
options.wiki_desc: sync xcursor theme with gsettings, it applies cursor-theme and cursor-size on theme load to gsettings making most CSD gtk based clients use same xcursor theme and size.

options.name: cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input
options.wiki_desc: Warp the cursor back to where it was after using a non-mouse input to move it, and then returning back to mouse.

options.name: ecosystem:no_update_news
options.wiki_desc: disable the popup that shows up when you update hyprland to a new version.

options.name: ecosystem:no_donation_nag
options.wiki_desc: disable the popup that shows up twice a year encouraging to donate.

options.name: ecosystem:enforce_permissions
options.wiki_desc: whether to enable [permission control](../../Advanced-and-Cool/Permissions).

options.name: debug:overlay
options.wiki_desc: print the debug performance overlay. Disable VFR for accurate results.

options.name: debug:damage_blink
options.wiki_desc: (epilepsy warning!) flash areas updated with damage tracking

options.name: debug:gl_debugging
options.wiki_desc: enables OpenGL debugging with glGetError and EGL_KHR_debug, requires a restart after changing.

options.name: debug:disable_logs
options.wiki_desc: disable logging to a file

options.name: debug:disable_time
options.wiki_desc: disables time logging

options.name: debug:damage_tracking
options.wiki_desc: redraw only the needed bits of the display. Do **not** change. (default: full - 2) monitor - 1, none - 0

options.name: debug:enable_stdout_logs
options.wiki_desc: enables logging to stdout

options.name: debug:manual_crash
options.wiki_desc: set to 1 and then back to 0 to crash Hyprland.
curation: action, not a setting: hide or button

options.name: debug:suppress_errors
options.wiki_desc: if true, do not display config file parsing errors.

options.name: debug:disable_scale_checks
options.wiki_desc: disables verification of the scale factors. Will result in pixel alignment and rounding errors.

options.name: debug:error_limit
options.wiki_desc: limits the number of displayed config file parsing errors.

options.name: debug:error_position
options.wiki_desc: sets the position of the error bar. top - 0, bottom - 1

options.name: debug:colored_stdout_logs
options.wiki_desc: enables colors in the stdout logs.

options.name: debug:log_damage
options.wiki_desc: enables logging the damage.

options.name: debug:pass
options.wiki_desc: enables render pass debugging.

options.name: debug:full_cm_proto
options.wiki_desc: claims support for all cm proto features (requires restart)

options.name: debug:ds_handle_same_buffer
options.wiki_desc: special case for direct scanout with unmodified buffer

options.name: debug:ds_handle_same_buffer_fifo
options.wiki_desc: special case for direct scanout with unmodified buffer unlocks fifo

options.name: debug:fifo_pending_workaround
options.wiki_desc: fifo workaround for empty pending list

options.name: debug:render_solitary_wo_damage
options.wiki_desc: render solitary window with empty damage

options.name: debug:vfr
options.wiki_desc: controls the VFR status of Hyprland. Heavily recommended to leave enabled to conserve resources.

options.name: debug:invalidate_fp16
options.wiki_desc: Allow fp16 buffer invalidation (invalidation increases performance but produces glitches on some systems). 0 - not allowed, 1 - allowed, 2 - not allowed on nvidia

options.name: layout:single_window_aspect_ratio
options.wiki_desc: whenever only a single window is shown on a screen, add padding so that it conforms to the specified aspect ratio. A value like `4 3` on a 16:9 screen will make it a 4:3 window in the middle with padding to the sides.

options.name: layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolerance
options.wiki_desc: sets a tolerance for `single_window_aspect_ratio`, so that if the padding that would have been added is smaller than the specified fraction of the height or width of the screen, it will not attempt to adjust the window size [0 - 1]
curation: wiki says int, source says Float

options.name: dwindle:force_split
options.wiki_desc: 0 -> split follows mouse, 1 -> always split to the left (new = left or top) 2 -> always split to the right (new = right or bottom)

options.name: dwindle:preserve_split
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, the split (side/top) will not change regardless of what happens to the container.

options.name: dwindle:smart_split
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, allows a more precise control over the window split direction based on the cursor's position. The window is conceptually divided into four triangles, and cursor's triangle determines the split direction. This feature also turns on preserve_split.

options.name: dwindle:smart_resizing
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window (nearest to which corner). Else, it is based on the window's tiling position.

options.name: dwindle:permanent_direction_override
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, makes the preselect direction persist until either this mode is turned off, another direction is specified, or a non-direction is specified (anything other than l,r,u/t,d/b)

options.name: dwindle:special_scale_factor
options.wiki_desc: specifies the scale factor of windows on the special workspace [0 - 1]

options.name: dwindle:split_width_multiplier
options.wiki_desc: specifies the auto-split width multiplier. Multiplying window size is useful on widescreen monitors where window W > H even after several splits.

options.name: dwindle:use_active_for_splits
options.wiki_desc: whether to prefer the active window or the mouse position for splits

options.name: dwindle:default_split_ratio
options.wiki_desc: the default split ratio on window open. 1 means even 50/50 split. [0.1 - 1.9]

options.name: dwindle:split_bias
options.wiki_desc: specifies which window will receive the split ratio. 0 -> directional (the top or left window), 1 -> the current window

options.name: dwindle:precise_mouse_move
options.wiki_desc: bindm movewindow will drop the window more precisely depending on where your mouse is.

options.name: master:allow_small_split
options.wiki_desc: enable adding additional master windows in a horizontal split style

options.name: master:special_scale_factor
options.wiki_desc: the scale of the special workspace windows. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: master:mfact
options.wiki_desc: the size as a percentage of the master window, for example `mfact = 0.70` would mean 70% of the screen will be the master window, and 30% the slave [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: master:new_status
options.wiki_desc: `"master"`: new window becomes master; `"slave"`: new windows are added to slave stack; `"inherit"`: inherit from focused window

options.name: master:new_on_top
options.wiki_desc: whether a newly open window should be on the top of the stack

options.name: master:new_on_active
options.wiki_desc: `"before"`, `"after"`: place new window relative to the focused window; `"none"`: place new window according to the value of `new_on_top`.

options.name: master:orientation
options.wiki_desc: default placement of the master area, can be `"left"`, `"right"`, `"top"`, `"bottom"` or `"center"`

options.name: master:slave_count_for_center_master
options.wiki_desc: when using orientation=center, make the master window centered only when at least this many slave windows are open. (Set 0 to always_center_master)

options.name: master:center_master_fallback
options.wiki_desc: Set fallback for center master when slaves are less than slave_count_for_center_master, can be `"left"`, `"right"`, `"top"`, `"bottom"`

options.name: master:smart_resizing
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window (nearest to which corner). Else, it is based on the window's tiling position.

options.name: master:drop_at_cursor
options.wiki_desc: when enabled, dragging and dropping windows will put them at the cursor position. Otherwise, when dropped at the stack side, they will go to the top/bottom of the stack depending on new_on_top.

options.name: master:always_keep_position
options.wiki_desc: whether to keep the master window in its configured position when there are no slave windows

options.name: master:focus_master_on_close
options.wiki_desc: when enabled, closing a window focuses the master window

options.name: scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column
options.wiki_desc: when enabled, a single column on a workspace will always span the entire screen.

options.name: scrolling:column_width
options.wiki_desc: the default width of a column, [0.1 - 1.0].

options.name: scrolling:focus_fit_method
options.wiki_desc: When a column is focused, what method should be used to bring it into view. 0 = center, 1 = fit

options.name: scrolling:follow_focus
options.wiki_desc: when a window is focused, should the layout move to bring it into view automatically

options.name: scrolling:follow_min_visible
options.wiki_desc: when a window is focused, require that at least a given fraction of it is visible for focus to follow. Hard input (e.g. binds, clicks) will always follow. [0.0 - 1.0]

options.name: scrolling:explicit_column_widths
options.wiki_desc: A comma-separated list of preconfigured widths for colresize +conf/-conf

options.name: scrolling:direction
options.wiki_desc: Direction in which new windows appear and the layout scrolls. `"left"`/`"right"`/`"down"`/`"up"`

options.name: scrolling:wrap_focus
options.wiki_desc: When enabled, causes `hl.dsp.layout("focus l/r")` to wrap around at the beginning and end.

options.name: scrolling:wrap_swapcol
options.wiki_desc: When enabled, causes `hl.dsp.layout("swapcol l/r")` to wrap around at the beginning and end.

options.name: experimental:wp_cm_1_2
options.wiki_desc: allow wp-cm-v1 version 2

options.name: input-capture:capture_modifiers
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, modifiers are also captured and sent to the program

options.name: input-capture:enforce_barriers
options.wiki_desc: if enabled, throw a wayland error when an invalid barrier is received

options.name: quirks:prefer_hdr
options.wiki_desc: Report HDR mode as preferred. 0 - off, 1 - always, 2 - gamescope only

options.name: quirks:skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats
options.wiki_desc: do not report dmabuf formats which cannot be imported into KMS
